title: Life-Area Coverage Gap Audit
dataSources: Daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`), personal SLO status (`personalslo:status`), cross-signal correlations (`correlation:pair`), plus every other `index=personal` sourcetype as input.
app: The meta layer — correlating every `index=personal` feed (sleep, activity, mood, weather, spend, productivity, home telemetry) into daily life scores, personal SLOs, and cross-signal anomaly detection, all computed in Splunk.
spl:
index=personal earliest=-30d
| stats count as events by domain sourcetype
| stats dc(sourcetype) as feeds, sum(events) as events by domain
| sort domain
description: Shows which life areas have broad instrumentation and which are mostly blind spots.
value: Coverage gaps matter because over-instrumenting one area and ignoring another can distort the story you tell yourself.
implementation: Tag feeds by domain such as health, home, money, and hobbies; summarize feed count and event volume by domain.
visualization: Domain table of contributing feeds and event counts.
grandmaExplanation: It logs which areas of life you are measuring well and which ones are still mostly a blind spot.
